name: OpenVibe.Deals

site.name: Deals
site.what: Deals submitted and voted on by the community, with source, price and freshness always shown, and crowdfunding: one search across Kickstarter, Indiegogo, GoFundMe and more.
site.description: OpenVibe.Deals is community deal discovery for the OpenVibe network: deals people vote on, hotness that reflects real interest, keyword alerts, price comparisons, honest discussion, and crowdfunding discovery across every platform at once.

pillars.title: Prices as of a time
pillars.text: Each deal keeps every price it was seen at, newest first, with its source. Nothing is called current without a fresh one.

pillars.title: Votes decide what is hot
pillars.text: One vote per person, counted on the server; a deal shows its hotness with the formula and the inputs.

pillars.title: Compare across stores
pillars.text: A product page lists every offer for it, each with its own latest price and when it was seen.

pillars.title: Watches and saved searches
pillars.text: Watch words, a product or a price limit for new prices that match, or save a search to run again.

pillars.title: Crowdfunding, every platform
pillars.text: One search opens Kickstarter, Indiegogo, GoFundMe, Open Collective and more, beside open-source campaigns with what they have raised.

site.keywords: openvibe deals, community deals, deal alerts, crowdfunding search, kickstarter alternative search

meanwhile.label: Coupons
meanwhile.note: The coupon room is the sibling of this one.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

drains: worker stopped (expiry, hotness, freshness, Sources, housekeeping)

resumes.what: the next worker tick applies stated expiries, hotness and freshness that fell due; every step is idempotent
the OpenVibe.Sources change feed is pulled again from the stored cursor, so items published during the stop arrive (idempotent per item revision)
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop (at least once; account_data_events applies each export and deletion once)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

leases.none: no claims: one process owns the ov_deals PostgreSQL database; writes are transactions there

notes: Port 4840. Owns deal_products, deal_product_aliases, deal_offers, deal_offer_sources, deal_votes, deal_hotness_snapshots, deal_watches, deal_price_observations, deal_flags (+ deal_stores) in its own PostgreSQL database (ov_deals). Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO, identity.subject.resolve), OpenVibe.Sources (sources.item.read; sources.item.* events only wake the pull), OpenVibe.Community (community.comment.write, community.comment.moderate) and publishes through OpenVibe.Events (events.event.publish); OpenVibe.Search reads deals.index_document.* from Events; OpenVibe.Network turns deals.watch.matched into notifications (server/notifications/events-consumer.js).
